name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in low-res frames without blurring edges, which directly boosts output sharpness—a 0.5%+ gain in perceived quality. The trade-off is extra compute per frame, but EXCAVA’s GPU cluster can absorb it without latency spikes.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it targets resolution, not facial feature accuracy—EXCAVA’s core flaw is identity drift, not blur. Instead, test RealVisXL’s face model with a controlled A/B: run 100 frames through EXCAVA’s current pipeline vs. the same pipeline + RealVisXL’s face model, then measure face similarity scores. If the score improves by ≥0.5%, adopt it; if not, drop it—no half-measures.
